item.title: Organization celebrates long running Polish Carnival tradition
item.description: PolishYoungstown hosted Ostatki 2026, transforming the long-running Polish Carnival tradition into a romantic, upscale night out at the Youngstown Country Club.

item.title: Local Dairy Queen makes Valentine's Day affordable for couples
item.description: For those not wanting to spend hundreds on Valentine's Day dinner, one local Dairy Queen has community members covered today.

item.title: Two dead, four injured in Cincinnati nightclub shooting; two detained
item.description: Four people were shot, and two of them are dead, after an alleged argument at a nightclub in Cincinnati early Sunday morning.

item.title: Darke County high school secretary arrested for alleged child seduction
item.description: According to the Union City Police Department, 31-year-old Alicia Hughes, an employee of the Randolph Eastern School Corporation, was arrested after an investigation into allegations involving inappropriate conduct with a juvenile.

item.title: Fairfield fire and hazmat incident: three injured, one missing
item.description: Three people were injured (two hospitalized) and one person is missing after a major three-alarm fire / critical hazmat response in Fairfield this Sunday morning.

item.title: Petition approved in effort to repeal Ohio's cannabis laws
item.description: The effort to repeal Ohio’s new cannabis law is making headway, now that Attorney General Dave Yost has approved the latest petition summary submitted by Ohioans For Cannabis Choice. Yost rejected the group's first petition summary last month, citing inaccuracies regarding Senate Bill 56, the law they wish to repeal.

item.title: The benefits of exercising in winter weather
item.description: If you're tired of working out at the gym this winter, you may want to consider going for a run outside instead. The change in scenery can offer many health benefits.

item.title: Animal Charity gives dogs the chance to meet their forever family at adoption event
item.description: Animal Charity of Ohio hosted an adoption event in the mall Sunday afternoon, giving more than 20 dogs the chance to find their next owner.

item.title: Person hospitalized after New Castle crash
item.description: One person has been hospitalized tonight after a crash in New Castle.
